correctness.rationale: The edge representation decomposes into antisymmetric clique edges and clique-by-independent cross edges. Averaging over signed permutation isometries reduces the unrestricted real l1 projection problem to equivariant projections. The cycle and cut representation decomposition leaves exactly one common standard constituent, so the explicit P_t exhausts all invariant projections. Its range and identity-on-cycles property establish idempotence. An exact Laplacian pseudoinverse gives two absolute column-sum formulas valid for all real t; convex minimax has a verified crossing for s<=3 and a cusp minimum for s>=4. The boundary r=2 and s=1 is explicitly included. Python standard-library exact rational verification passed 56 graph pairs, 1932 columns, 1754 idempotence entries;

value.rationale: This computes a natural, unrestricted Banach-space relative projection constant across a two-parameter family of standard split graphs. The optimizer switches mechanism at exactly four independent vertices; thereafter the optimum depends only on clique size, even as edge dimension grows, whereas the orthogonal projector remains strictly nonoptimal for s>4. The nonvanishing limiting canonical/optimal ratio (2, 3/2, or 4/3 depending on clique size) provides a structural benchmark, not an arbitrary numerical table or incremental special case.
